# Milestone brief — verification-contract-m1

**Title:** Honest verification statuses & five-operation contract design
**Kind:** milestone
**Roadmap:** verification-contract (plans/verification-contract/roadmap.yaml)
**Status:** planned
**Lane:** now
**Target:** 2026-08-04 -> 2026-08-10

## Parent epic

- verification-contract-e1 — Honest verification statuses & contract design
  Rename status="ok" to elaborated_no_errors, redesign the lean_verify response schema to conform to the R0 trust-language policy, and author the ADR defining the five-operation contract (parse_source / elaborate_signature / check_declaration / audit_axioms / strict_replay_proof). No operation lands yet — this epic only ensures no response leaving the server can be misread as a trust verdict from this point forward.

## Summary

Rename status="ok" to elaborated_no_errors, redesign the lean_verify response schema to conform to the R0 trust-language policy (no bare "verified", multi-axis trust record), and author the ADR defining the five-operation contract. Re-pins EXPECTED_TOOL_SCHEMA_SHA256, EXPECTED_BP1_SHA256, and the affected server/schemas/*.json version fields as its own work (W1/W2 batch windows are closed).

## Acceptance criteria

1. Given a lean_verify response that previously carried status="ok", when the handler runs post-rename, then it returns status="elaborated_no_errors" and no response field anywhere in the schema reads bare "verified"
2. Given the redesigned response schema, when it is checked against .claude/docs/trust-language-policy.md, then no single field collapses distinct trust questions (elaboration vs kernel-check vs axiom-audit vs replay) into one token
3. Given the LEAN_VERIFY.description bytes change, when pytest --update-tool-schema-hash and the hand-edited EXPECTED_BP1_SHA256 are applied, then tests/test_server_tool_schema.py and tests/test_prompts.py both pass and every affected server/schemas/*.json version field is bumped
4. Given the five-operation ADR (parse_source / elaborate_signature / check_declaration / audit_axioms / strict_replay_proof), when it is committed, then it defines each operation's inputs, isolation dependency, and target-binding behavior without implementing any operation
